headlines.title: Costco Wholesale Stock Loses to 10-Year U.S. Treasury Notes on Yield. Here's Why It Wins on Everything Else.
headlines.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield just hit 5.2%, dwarfing Costco's dividend. Here's why the warehouse retailer still looks like the better long-term buy.

headlines.title: Is a $65 Costco Membership Worth It for Groceries? We Priced 27 Staples
headlines.summary: As a grocery store that requires a $65 annual membership to shop, one might expect Costco’s prices would be much lower than average. But the answer is complicated. The chain does offer cheap per-item prices, but they sell things in bulk.

headlines.title: Costco Wholesale (COST) Posts 13% September Sales Growth, Is The Stock Now Too Pricey?
headlines.summary: Costco Wholesale (COST) just reported September net sales of US$30.02b, up 13.0% from US$26.58b a year ago. That monthly update is the immediate catalyst for renewed attention on the stock. The sales update comes against a backdrop of steady gains for Costco Wholesale, with a year-to-date share price return of 10.82% and a three-year total shareholder return of 72.19%.

headlines.title: What Cheaper Gas Would Mean For Costco’s Sales And Margins
headlines.summary: Costco Wholesale (COST) stock currently trades at 45.6 times earnings, compared with 21.9 for the S&P 500. Investors paying that price may be counting on growth. That growth has materialized, as September net sales rose 13.0% from a year earlier. However, gas hit $4.32 a gallon in mid-September, and those higher fuel costs add to Costco's sales. So how much of that growth would go if gas prices came back down.

headlines.title: Costco's 19% September Digital Sales Growth Signals Strong Momentum
headlines.summary: Costco's digital sales surge 19% in September 2026, extending strong fiscal 2026 momentum as expanded delivery options and personalization fuel growth.

description: Costco Wholesale Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation of membership warehouses in the United States, Puerto Rico, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the United Kingdom, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France, Iceland, New Zealand, and Sweden. It offers merchandise, including sundries, dry groceries, candies, coolers, freezers, deli, liquor, and tobacco; non-food merchandise comprising appliances, small electronics, health and beauty aids, hardware, lawn and garden, sporting goods, tires, toys and seasonal, automotive, stamps, tickets, apparel, furniture, domestics, housewares, special order kiosks, and jewelry; and fresh food, such as meat, produce, service deli, and bakery products. The company is also involved in warehouse ancillary operations, which include gasoline, pharmacies, optical, food courts, hearing-aid centers, and tire installation centers. In addition, it engages in e-commerce, business centers, travel, and other businesses. The company was formerly known as Costco Companies, Inc. and changed its name to Costco Wholesale Corporation in August 1999. Costco Wholesale Corporation was founded in 1976 and is based in Issaquah, Washington.
